Review: I know there have been hundreds of positive reviews, but to each his own, and this Thayers toner didn't work for me. I was really looking for a natural replacement to the one I used for a couple of years (Beauty Jam) that was the best I'd ever had. Since Beauty Jam had a focus on natural ingredients, Thayers seemed like a good choice. Alcohol free, witch hazel, and cucumber extract to calm the skin - but it had the opposite effect.My skin felt really dried out immediately after using. In the morning, after supposedly healing and calming my skin all night long, I was very disappointed. My pores had noticeably created more oil, and yet my skin felt drawn tight and dried out. I gave this toner a few weeks to adjust to my skin (and I used it twice a day) but it never got any better. Also, I got zits, which is not great. With Beauty Jam, I got about 1 zit every 2 weeks, and the ingredients in the toner helped combat the blemish and get rid of it right away. With Thayers, I got about 4-5 zits a week, and it did nothing to reduce them in a speedy manner.On the plus side, the bottle is huge! If this product does agree with you, you'll definitely get a lot for your money. And the fragrance is very nice. I might try to find some other use for it, like adding it to a scalp mask.

Review: I’ve been on the hunt for a new toner to substitute into my AM & PM skincare routine. Thayers witch hazel toner has a massive social media following, so I decided to try it out in my search. Originally, I wanted to opt for the original formula to avoid unnecessary fragrances, but I’ve been in a floral phase lately... Some people can develop allergic reactions to witch hazel though it is known for anti-inflammatory effects acne.With initial usage once daytime and nighttime, I started experiencing localized breakouts around my cheek and forehead. My normal skin is usually breakout free. I was pretty disappointed, but also really wanted to give this product a chance and my skin to adapt to the regimen. I dropped usage to once daily nighttime as I waited for the breakouts to subside. Now, I still use it only nighttime before bed and have residual pigmentation leftover. No more active breakouts though.I still enjoy this product for occasional use as a light refresher after cleansing and before moisturizing, but know it may not be the best product for everyone. It’s a large bottle for an affordable price that will last me for a long time based on my use. Most likely will not repurchase because it doesn’t have the WOW effect on me that it’s been touted for.

Review Title: Sensitive Skin? Small Pores? DON'T USE.
Review: The best thing about this toner is the smell. It's refreshing and light, and I really enjoyed it. However, I was sorely disappointed after a few weeks of using it to see that my acne and pores have actually gotten worse; both were now darker, larger, and more painful. Review: Thayer's description on this (Amazon) website is fraudulent.  I've attached a screen grab of the advertised ingredients list, but in case the text is too tiny to read, here's what it says:"Ingredients: Purified Water, Certified Organic Witch Hazel Ext Blend (Hamamelis Virginiana Extract (Witch Hazel*), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice (Filet of Aloe Vera*)), Glycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Fragrance (Natural Witch Hazel), Citric Acid, Citrus Grandis (Grapefruit) Seed Extract"Note that witch hazel is listed as the second ingredient, right after water.However, as you can see in the other photo, that I snapped at home, the ingredients listed on the bottle--for this same product--aren't what is being advertised. For everyone else: if you want real witch hazel get the Forever Pure.

Review Title: Toners are a waste of money

Review Title: I like that it came in a pack of three but it smells funky...
Review: PRICE - 2/5. It’s nice that it came through the mail and in a three pack. If you’re quarantining due to Covid and want to keep your skin care routine in line, then get this. However, if you’re not stuck at home, then just go to the store and buy these for about $5 (or less depending where you live). This product feels nice on my skin, doesn’t irritate it. It helps control the size of my pores and I don’t feel so oily throughout the day. Also, I usually feel oily after applying moisturizer but if I apply moisturizer DIRECTLY after this toner, then my face feels nice and soft and not oily at all.USE 3/5- The only reason why I am giving this a 3 rather than a 5 (because I love this product) is because it smells funky. I would relate it to maybe the smell of smoke, cigars and ash... Or gasonline? I’m not sure how to explain it, but other than that... It is AWESOME for everyday use! If you can get used to the smokey/ashy type of smell, then get it.OVERALL - 3/5! The package did not include any bubble wrap and it came damaged. So while I love the product, I highly recommend purchasing in person. I actually never recommend to purchase something with liquid or anything spillable through any sort of delivery service, not just Amazon. Other than that, both this product and Amazon are perfect (separately).

Review: This was a sketchy product.... Mind you, it is quite a well known product and has even won either a Allay or Goodhouse Keeping beauty award (though,,, don't quote me on that) and I have even seen a few of my friends carry around this product but it is not for me... Another turn-off was the actually bottle which is comprised of a hard, cheap plastic which lead to the bottle cap breaking off when I was 3/4 done with the product. I wasn't really worried over it, since I just kept it upright, but during that time, it was fruit fly season and the oddest thing started happening, fruit flies would sneak into the container and drown until I had many lifeless insect bodies floating in my toner. I still haven't put my finger on why they were so attracted to the witch hazel toner but at that point, I was so fed up with the product, I threw it out and haven't looked back since. There are many great toners on the market but this one just didn't do it for me. :(

Review Title: Pure natural product, unpleasant natural aroma - here's a quick fix for the aroma
Review: I have oily skin and I purchased this product as a replacement for a long-time favorite pore-refining toner that was sadly discontinued. I wanted something alcohol-based, to cut the oil, and something that would close my pores, which is what witch hazel does. This is pure witch hazel, which is naturally tinctured with alcohol, so it seemed ideal. Unfortunately, witch hazel itself has an unpleasant aroma, so even though this is "unscented" it isn't without scent. I put a few drops of food-grade lavender extract into it (alcohol-based tincture), and it helped, so I think people could get creative and try whatever other alcohol-based flavoring agent they like in it to mask the witch hazel aroma. This would solve the problem most people find with this otherwise good product. One thing to note: Dickinson's is a fairly mild astringent, not as strong as the pore-refining toners that contain salicylic acid.

Review: I hate my nose. That's it. My nose was ruined because during puberty I only had zits growing on my nose so I used a lot of different stuffs on it. So now I have been doing this for 2months and I can see my blackheads are like 1/3 size of they use to be, my nose feels much more smooth than before. Only thing with this toner is the smell, I don't think they add any artificial fragrance in so it is not a good smell, what I do is whenever I have my mask on, I spray a few times with the other rose toner to mask the smell.

Review Title: BRING BACK BLUE BOTTLE!  My skin feels FRESHER just wiping with WATER than this
Review: EDIT:  some reviewers are saying the SAME product as what was in the old blue bottle.  NO IT ISN'T.  I had the blue bottle and compared ingredients.  NOT the same.  Pores don't feel as toned as they did with blue bottle, my face felt more hydrated, now feels more oily than hydrated.  WISH THEY WOULD BRING BACK BLUE BOTTLE!_______________________________________________________I have used the Neutrogena blue bottle toner for many years.  I loved it was oil and alcohol free and that it made my face feel really clean with a very slight tingle.I got a bottle about every two months.  I went to reorder and this was the only one I saw that was similar and I thought just a rebranding til I compared ingredients.Just used it and what I noticed...I don't get the same sense of clean and the slight tingle.  Blue bottle made my pores even feel a little smaller or tighter.While this doesn't irritate my skin, I also don't feel it really cleans it as well as the blue bottle.It isn't drying, but my face doesn't feel quite as smooth after using it as the blue bottle.I do like there is very little scent.Would this work to take off make up or a quick kind of refresh?  Yes.Is it good no alcohol?  For me, definitely Yes.Would I rather the blue bottle and it's ingredients, which I checked and are different, not just a rebrand, be back?  BIG YES.BOTTOMLINE:  Unless and until I find something better, I will reorder this new alcohol free toner, but I miss the BLUE BOTTLE Alcohol Free one!
